subject: Binom_coeff_log in fvar broken after merge master

messages.author: 839dfa09184985a5
messages.subject: Binom_coeff_log in fvar broken after merge master
parts:
When I merged master to the fvar branch to update includes to reflect the refactoring, I got an error for binom_coeff_log(const T1& x1, const fvar<T2>& x2). The code for in the fvar file is

template <typename T1, typename T2>
inline
fvar<typename stan::return_type<T1,T2>::type>
binomial_coefficient_log(const T1& x1, const fvar<T2>& x2){
using boost::math::digamma;
using std::log;
using stan::math::binomial_coefficient_log;
const double cutoff = 1000;
if ((x1 < cutoff) || (x1 - x2.val_ < cutoff)) {
return fvar<typename stan::return_type<T1,T2>::type>(
binomial_coefficient_log(x1, x2.val_),
- x2.d_ * digamma(x2.val_ + 1)
- x2.d_ * digamma(x1 - x2.val_ + 1));
} else {
return fvar<typename stan::return_type<T1,T2>::type>(
binomial_coefficient_log(x1, x2.val_), x2.d_
* log(x1 - x2.val_) + (x2.val_ * (0 - x2.d_)) / (x1 - x2.val_))
+ 0 * log(x1 / (x1 - x2.val_)) + (x1 + 0.5) / (x1 / (x1 - x2.val_))
* (0 * (x1 - x2.val_) - (0 - x2.d_) * x1) / ((x1 - x2.val_)
* (x1 - x2.val_)) + 0 / (12 * x1 * x1) - x2.d_ + (0 - x2.d_)
/ (12 * (x1 - x2.val_) * (x1 - x2.val_)
- digamma(x2.val_ + 1) * x2.d_);
}
}

The test code giving the error is

double w = 2006.0;
fvar<double> y(1002.0);
y.d_ = 2.0;

fvar<double> c = binomial_coefficient_log(w, y);

EXPECT_FLOAT_EQ(binomial_coefficient_log(2006.0, 1002.0), c.val_);
EXPECT_FLOAT_EQ(2.0 * log(2006.0 - 1002.0) + (1002.0 * (0 - 2.0))
/ (2006.0 - 1002.0) + 0 * log(2006.0 / (2006.0 - 1002.0))
+ (2006.0 + 0.5) / (2006.0 / (2006.0 - 1002.0)) * (0
* (2006.0 - 1002.0) - (0 - 2.0) * 2006.0) / ((2006.0 - 1002.0)
* (2006.0 - 1002.0)) + 0 / (12 * 2006.0 * 2006.0) - 2.0
+ (0 - 2.0) / (12 * (2006.0 - 1002.0) * (2006.0 - 1002.0))
- digamma(1002.0 + 1) * 2.0, c.d_);

After testing, I found that there was nothing wrong with the binom_coeff_log fvar file, as I used print statements to print out the values that should've been stored as c.val_ and c.d_--these were correct.

However, something is causing the wrong c.val_ and c.d_ to be returned--the returned values are the ones that should be returned if (x1 < cutoff) || (x1 - x2.val_ < cutoff). This is particularly confusing since when I added a print statement in the if loop to see if it was ever called, nothing was printed..



Thanks,
Peter

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Binom_coeff_log in fvar broken after merge master
parts:
On 4/10/13 6:59 PM, Peter Li wrote:
> When I merged master to the fvar branch to update includes to reflect the refactoring, I got an error for binom_coeff_log(const T1& x1, const fvar<T2>& x2). The code for in the fvar file is
>
> template <typename T1, typename T2>
> inline
> fvar<typename stan::return_type<T1,T2>::type>
> binomial_coefficient_log(const T1& x1, const fvar<T2>& x2){
> using boost::math::digamma;
> using std::log;
> using stan::math::binomial_coefficient_log;
> const double cutoff = 1000;
> if ((x1 < cutoff) || (x1 - x2.val_ < cutoff)) {

binomial_coefficient_log only technically makes sense for integers,
but we've generalized it by replacing the factorials with gamma
functions.

If we don't ever call this with negative values for x2,
then you only need the second test here.

> return fvar<typename stan::return_type<T1,T2>::type>(
> binomial_coefficient_log(x1, x2.val_),
> - x2.d_ * digamma(x2.val_ + 1)
> - x2.d_ * digamma(x1 - x2.val_ + 1));
> } else {
> return fvar<typename stan::return_type<T1,T2>::type>(
> binomial_coefficient_log(x1, x2.val_), x2.d_
> * log(x1 - x2.val_) + (x2.val_ * (0 - x2.d_)) / (x1 - x2.val_))
> + 0 * log(x1 / (x1 - x2.val_)) + (x1 + 0.5) / (x1 / (x1 - x2.val_))
> * (0 * (x1 - x2.val_) - (0 - x2.d_) * x1) / ((x1 - x2.val_)
> * (x1 - x2.val_)) + 0 / (12 * x1 * x1) - x2.d_ + (0 - x2.d_)
> / (12 * (x1 - x2.val_) * (x1 - x2.val_)
> - digamma(x2.val_ + 1) * x2.d_);
> }

You should format these long statements into terms that can be more easily
digested. For long sums, I use the following format:

return fvar<typename stan::return_type<T1,T2>::type>(
binomial_coefficient_log(x1, x2.val_),
x2.d_ * log(x1 - x2.val_)
+ (x2.val_ * (0 - x2.d_)) / (x1 - x2.val_))
+ 0 * log(x1 / (x1 - x2.val_))
+ (x1 + 0.5) / (x1 / (x1 - x2.val_))
* (0 * (x1 - x2.val_) - (0 - x2.d_) * x1) / ((x1 - x2.val_)
* (x1 - x2.val_))
+ 0 / (12 * x1 * x1)
- x2.d_
+ (0 - x2.d_) / (12 * (x1 - x2.val_) * (x1 - x2.val_)
- digamma(x2.val_ + 1) * x2.d_
);
> }
>
> The test code giving the error is
>
> double w = 2006.0;
> fvar<double> y(1002.0);
> y.d_ = 2.0;
>
> fvar<double> c = binomial_coefficient_log(w, y);

This is good that you're testing with a multiplier of 2.0
in y.d_. It tests that we're not forgetting to multiply,
which is easy to do if the initial derivative is 1.0.

> EXPECT_FLOAT_EQ(binomial_coefficient_log(2006.0, 1002.0), c.val_);
> EXPECT_FLOAT_EQ(2.0 * log(2006.0 - 1002.0) + (1002.0 * (0 - 2.0))
> / (2006.0 - 1002.0) + 0 * log(2006.0 / (2006.0 - 1002.0))
> + (2006.0 + 0.5) / (2006.0 / (2006.0 - 1002.0)) * (0
> * (2006.0 - 1002.0) - (0 - 2.0) * 2006.0) / ((2006.0 - 1002.0)
> * (2006.0 - 1002.0)) + 0 / (12 * 2006.0 * 2006.0) - 2.0
> + (0 - 2.0) / (12 * (2006.0 - 1002.0) * (2006.0 - 1002.0))
> - digamma(1002.0 + 1) * 2.0, c.d_);
>
> After testing, I found that there was nothing wrong with the binom_coeff_log fvar file, as I used print statements to print out the values that should've been stored as c.val_ and c.d_--these were correct.
>
> However, something is causing the wrong c.val_ and c.d_ to be returned--the returned values are the ones that should be returned if (x1 < cutoff) || (x1 - x2.val_ < cutoff). This is particularly confusing since when I added a print statement in the if loop to see if it was ever called, nothing was printed..

I'd go back and recheck these steps. I don't have any better suggestion
than tracing. You can try calling the fvar version of binomial_coefficient_log
directly. If your function's not getting called, something else must be.
Are you sure you have the right include statements in place?

- Bob
